revert_tags_for_reference.note: Use for byte-identical verification; do NOT edit tags

acceptance_criteria.title: Sandbox Green
acceptance_criteria.spec: cd apps/macro-indicators && go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=all -module=macro-indicators -scenario=all exits 0, total=20 pass=20 fail=0 status=OK

acceptance_criteria.title: Hard Gates Clean
acceptance_criteria.spec: All 5 hard-gate commands exit 0: anchor HELD, R-1 exit 1, Fence-B exit 1 both, Fence-C exit 1, scenario dir clean

acceptance_criteria.title: SSOT Untouched
acceptance_criteria.spec: Do NOT modify docs/data/pilot-status-macro-indicators.json; PM will update at cycle close

acceptance_criteria.title: Done Signal Written
acceptance_criteria.spec: Write docs/signals/dev-macro-p2-d2-fix-DONE-<UTC>.json with byte_identical_verification + sandbox_result + hard_gates_status + cycle_used

constraints: L84 Explicit Staging: Only git add the constant fix file + signal file; NO -A, NO .
Fix is literal only: HotMoneyThreshold = 5.0 → 2.5; no refactoring, no comments, no other files
No TA zone touches, no CI config changes, no sandbox scenario edits

cycle_counting.cycle_2: if dev needs follow-up dispatch from PM
cycle_counting.pass_condition: byte-identical restore within ≤2 cycles, sandbox 20/20 GREEN, hard gates clean
cycle_counting.fail_condition: more than 2 cycles, or non-byte-identical fix, or sandbox RED, or hard gate fails

g10_pass_fail.PASS: Byte-identical restore ≤2 cycles + sandbox 20/20 + hard gates clean → G10 = YES
g10_pass_fail.FAIL: Any of: >2 cycles, non-byte-identical, sandbox RED, hard gate fails → G10 = NO

commit_message_pattern: fix(macro-indicators): P2-D2 — byte-identical restore HotMoneyThreshold 5.0→2.5 (G10 fixability proof)
next_steps: Dev completes P2-D2 → writes done signal
PM/QA awaits in cycle-55 or cycle-56 depending on dev completion speed
QA re-verifies sandbox independently → writes verification signal
PM closes P2-D2 (atomic commit) → flips G10=YES (if all criteria PASS) → updates SSOT goalsEarned
Ultimately: PO decides verdict after 12/12 goals reach terminal grade

hard_gates_reference.1_anchor_held: git merge-base --is-ancestor 1776df8e HEAD && echo PASS || echo FAIL
hard_gates_reference.2_r1_deterministic: grep -rE 'math/rand|rand\.Intn|rand\.Float' apps/macro-indicators/pkg/ && echo FAIL || echo PASS
hard_gates_reference.3_fence_b_clean: grep -rE 'import.*infrastructure|import.*infra' apps/macro-indicators/pkg/module/ && echo FAIL || echo PASS
hard_gates_reference.4_fence_c_clean: grep -rE 'package infrastructure' apps/macro-indicators/pkg/ --include='*.go' | grep -v 'pkg/module' && echo FAIL || echo PASS
hard_gates_reference.5_scenario_clean: cd apps/macro-indicators && git status docs/scenarios/macro-indicators/ | grep -E 'modified|new file' && echo FAIL || echo PASS
